Common questions

Can I attend classes online or in person? ▾

You can choose whichever format suits you best. We conduct in-person classes at our centre in Kondur, Cuddalore, as well as live interactive online classes on Google Meet / Zoom. Both options follow the same 12-week practical curriculum with small groups and live trainer guidance.

What is the fee and are there any extra charges? ▾

The fee is ₹500 per month. There is zero registration fee, no admission charges, and no long-term commitment. You simply pay month-by-month as you learn.

How many classes are held each week and what is the batch size? ▾

There are 3 live classes per week over 12 weeks (36 interactive sessions total). Each batch is strictly capped at 6 to 10 learners so every student receives individual attention, speaking practice, and direct feedback in every session.

What happens during the 10-minute speaking assessment? ▾

It is a short, friendly conversation with our trainer to assess your current speaking comfort and understand your goals. There is zero written testing, grammar interrogation, or pressure. It simply helps us place you in the right batch (Beginner or Intermediate).

I make grammar mistakes and feel nervous speaking English. Can I join? ▾

Yes, absolutely. Most of our students understand English but struggle with hesitation, finding the right words, or fear of making mistakes. Our small, supportive batches are designed specifically to help you overcome hesitation and build speaking confidence from day one.

How do I enrol or confirm my slot? ▾

You can tap "Talk to a Counsellor" in the header to connect directly on WhatsApp, or fill out the enquiry form below. Our counsellor will share current batch timings and arrange your 10-minute speaking assessment.
